title: Mirror world
_map: Mirror world (Y2). Big idea: lines of symmetry. Creative: design a symmetrical house or butterfly; the robot builds half wrong for him to fix.
_story: The robot builds a house in blocks, but only one half. A mirror line shows how the other half must look. Then the robot builds a whole house with a mistake for Ismaeel to spot.
_stepChain: a mirror (disco: reflect) shows a flipped copy → fold line: both halves match → that line is called a line of symmetry → complete the other half → spot the robot's mistake → design your own

talk.goodAnswer: both halves match exactly, like a reflection in a mirror along the line.

talk.ask: How did you spot the robot's mistake?
talk.goodAnswer: one window wasn't in the matching place on the other side of the line.

handsOn: Fold a piece of paper in half, paint blobs on one side, then fold and press. Open it up: a symmetrical butterfly! Or build a symmetrical house from Lego.

narration.speaker: robot
narration.text: I started building a house, but I only finished one half! I want both sides to match perfectly.

Imagine a mirror standing right down the middle. Each block on this side has a twin on the other side, the same distance from the mirror. A line where both halves match like that is called a line of symmetry.

narration.speaker: robot
narration.text: Now I built a whole house by myself. It's perfectly symmetrical. I think.

question.onRight: Yes, you spotted it. The window on the right is one block too far out.

0.mistake: looked at the whole shape but didn't compare each pair of twins
0.hint: Look at the windows. Is each one the same distance from the line?
0.say: Compare the windows. The left window is one block from the edge of the wall. The right window is right at the edge. They don't match, so it isn't symmetrical.

question.reveal: Moving the window one block in makes both sides match.

narration.text: Symmetry is everywhere. A butterfly's wings. Your face. A leaf. A Minecraft creeper face too! Look around and find something symmetrical.
Now design your own symmetrical house, or a butterfly. Build one half, then copy each block to the other side of the line, the same distance away.

rule.text: Symmetrical: both halves match across the line.
rule.ask: Can you say what a line of symmetry is? Say it out loud. Then tap the eye.
rule.spoken: A line of symmetry splits a shape into two halves that match exactly, like a reflection in a mirror.

bonus.prompt: Bonus: how many lines of symmetry does a square have?
bonus.reveal: 4! Up and down, side to side, and both diagonals.
